info.title: Nethereum MainnetChain Server
info.description: Nethereum MainnetChain Server - thin CLI host for the Nethereum.MainnetChain library (read-only mainnet follower + JSON-RPC serving). All composition lives in Nethereum.MainnetChain so it can also be hosted from Aspire or tests.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Read-only Ethereum mainnet follower: syncs, validates, and serves mainnet over JSON-RPC.

options.name: --port
options.description: JSON-RPC port (default: 8545)

options.name: --host
options.description: Host to bind to (default: 127.0.0.1)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Verbose logging

options.name: --metrics-port
options.description: Expose Prometheus /metrics on this port (default: off)

options.name: --data-dir
options.description: Chain data directory (default: ./mainnet-data)

options.name: --no-snap
options.description: Skip snap sync (snap is the default; a full sync is impractical for mainnet)

options.name: --listen-port
options.description: Also serve snap/eth to other peers (default: off)

options.name: --beacon
options.description: Beacon REST endpoint (enables the light-client gate)

options.name: --allow-unverified-consensus
options.description: Start WITHOUT a beacon (no consensus verification; NOT recommended for mainnet)

options.name: --engine
options.description: Serve the Engine API so a consensus client (Lighthouse) drives the follower; excludes --beacon

options.name: --genesis
options.description: Custom chain: a geth-format genesis.json (chain id, fork schedule, alloc). Needs --engine; runs with no peers, no snap and no light client, and serves debug_setHead when --MainnetChain:RpcModules includes debug

options.name: --engine-port
options.description: Engine API port (default: 8551)

options.name: --engine-jwt-secret
options.description: JWT secret file shared with the consensus client (default: <data-dir>/jwt.hex, created if missing)

options.name: --wipe-state
options.description: One-shot: clear state, keeping the block archive, then exit; the next start re-runs the state sync

options.name: --rebuild-state-from-flat
options.description: One-shot: rebuild stale storage-trie nodes from flat state, then verify

options.name: --verify-flat
options.description: One-shot: write-free flat/trie verify at the committed head, logs the full breakdown, then stops

options.name: --verify-flat-sample
options.description: With --verify-flat: verify only the first N accounts per shard (0 = full walk, default)

options.name: --flush-cadence
options.description: Persist state every N blocks (default 1 = every block)

options.name: --cache-size
options.description: RocksDB block cache size, e.g. 4G / 512M (default 1G)

options.name: --rocksdb-statistics
options.description: Collect RocksDB statistics and log block-cache counters every 100 blocks
